acrobatics.name: Acrobatics
acrobatics.desc: Stay on your feet in a tricky situation, or perform an acrobatic stunt.
animal-handling.name: Animal Handling
animal-handling.desc: Calm or train an animal, or get an animal to behave in a certain way.
arcana.name: Arcana
arcana.desc: Recall lore about spells, magic items, and the planes of existence.
athletics.name: Athletics
athletics.desc: Jump farther than normal, stay afloat in rough water, or break something.
deception.name: Deception
deception.desc: Tell a convincing lie, or wear a disguise convincingly.
history.name: History
history.desc: Recall lore about historical events, people, nations, and cultures.
insight.name: Insight
insight.desc: Discern a person’s mood and intentions.
intimidation.name: Intimidation
intimidation.desc: Awe or threaten someone into doing what you want.
investigation.name: Investigation
investigation.desc: Find obscure information in books, or deduce how something works.
medicine.name: Medicine
medicine.desc: Diagnose an illness, or determine what killed the recently slain.
nature.name: Nature
nature.desc: Recall lore about terrain, plants, animals, and weather.
perception.name: Perception
perception.desc: Using a combination of senses, notice something that’s easy to miss.
performance.name: Performance
performance.desc: Act, tell a story, perform music, or dance.
persuasion.name: Persuasion
persuasion.desc: Honestly and graciously convince someone of something.
religion.name: Religion
religion.desc: Recall lore about gods, religious rituals, and holy symbols.
sleight-of-hand.name: Sleight of Hand
sleight-of-hand.desc: Pick a pocket, conceal a handheld object, or perform legerdemain.
stealth.name: Stealth
stealth.desc: Escape notice by moving quietly and hiding behind things.
survival.name: Survival
survival.desc: Follow tracks, forage, find a trail, or avoid natural hazards.
